summary: DPC Holdings PLC filed a Form 8-K after its subsidiaries Doncasters Limited and Doncasters Inc. entered a $325 million senior unsecured multi-currency revolving credit facility with lenders and Barclays Bank PLC as administrative agent on September 3, 2026. The facility, which also includes an uncommitted $150 million accordion, a $50 million swingline sub-facility and a $50 million letter of credit sub-facility, matures September 3, 2029 and prices off Term SOFR, EURIBOR, STR, SONIA or a base rate across six leverage-based levels. No special-situation transaction is present.
